evals.prompt: I have no budget, can work 10 hours a week, and have operations and IT experience. Give me 10 online business ideas that could plausibly reach $100/day within 90 days, rank them, and choose one.
evals.expected_output: Ten ranked ideas with explicit monetization math, assumptions, validation tests, and a selected winner.

evals.prompt: I picked a missed-call follow-up service for HVAC contractors. Build a 30-day launch plan with free tools, pricing, daily tasks, and milestones.
evals.expected_output: A day-by-day execution plan that validates demand before building, includes pricing and fulfillment, and defines stop/go milestones.

evals.prompt: I sell a $500/month bookkeeping service to small contractors and currently have 8 clients. Give me five specific ways to double revenue in 60 days using upsells, automation, retention, and new traffic.
evals.expected_output: Revenue-equation analysis, five ranked growth levers, concrete tests, arithmetic, and kill criteria without guaranteed results.
